name: jyut-ocr-proofread
description: Transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs and OCR Markdown with Cantonese jyut-ocr conventions and risk-based structural or release audits.

interface.shortDescription: Transcribe and audit historical Chinese PDF OCR.
interface.longDescription: Use a Cantonese jyut-ocr workflow to transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs while preserving printed glyph variants and old punctuation. Start with page-by-page visual review, then enable only the structural, source-apparatus, long-document or replayable release gates that the material actually needs.
defaultPrompt: 校對一份 jyut-ocr Markdown，逐頁對同名 PDF。
識別一份長篇歷史中文 PDF，分段校對後安全合併。
識別文件特徵，再核對適用嘅長目錄、題名註、表格或跨頁結構。
